title: Religious Bias Landscape in Language and Text-to-Image Models: Analysis, Detection, and Debiasing Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using mask filling, prompt completion, and text-to-image generation with prompts containing negative actions or stereotypical adjectives to observe which religious groups are predicted or depicted.
Conducting a cross-domain analysis to see which nationalities language models disproportionately associate with specific religions when negative descriptors (e.g., 'terrorist') are applied.
Altering gender pronouns (e.g., 'He' vs. 'She') in mask-filling prompts to analyze how gender influences the model's prediction of religious affiliation for negatively characterized individuals.
Substituting age-related descriptors (e.g., 'young' vs. 'elderly') in prompts to examine their impact on the models' attribution of religion to individuals described with negative traits.
